payload.body: Go on your code-comment audit, hv's ask (fix what's written to match what's built). Apply A1-A21, B (both to the past tense), C (drop each number or name the things; alacritty.sh:10 names the rule by its subject) and D (dev-tools hint names curl and not fd; editors hint names the emacs-plus that :23-46 expects, without a version number if the code takes any numbered one). Keep the incident figures in history notes (git.sh:8, backup.sh:156, editors.sh:83, :354-355, :377): they measure a past event and cannot go stale, so they are not the stored counts hv's rule is about. Leave docs/guides/new-user.md:76 to dc. Comments and message strings only; change no logic. Run the suite under Homebrew bash and /bin/bash 3.2 and shellcheck; commit on main by pathspec, unpushed; send vc the commit and the result. vc reviews and pushes.
